sourceText.he: חוֹמֶר בְּכִסּוּי וְכוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן, ״כִּי יִקָּרֵא קַן צִפּוֹר לְפָנֶיךָ״ – מָה תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר?

positions.claim: covering the blood applies to undomesticated animals and to birds, whether readily available or not, whereas sending away the mother applies only to birds that are not readily available
